comparison.objective: Swipe a magnetic-stripe card through a reader at a valid speed and return it to its stand.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient a thin card, maintain narrow-slot alignment, and execute a continuous speed-bounded pass.
comparison.success_condition: A single valid read across the encoded span, followed by stable released placement in the stand; extra or failed swipes reduce credit and dropping fails.
comparison.reason: The candidate tests coupled screw adjustment, jam-nut counterholding, and retained gripper motion; card-slot trajectory control and read completion are different abilities.
